name: multi-agent-shogun
description: ChatGPT Work-native multi-agent orchestration with visible, evidence-based coordination updates.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work and watch a verified period-drama council.
interface.longDescription: Runs a ChatGPT Work-native Shogun formation: one lead agent plans and integrates while up to three subagents execute independent work, with concise Sengoku-period drama summaries of real delegation, reports, challenges, and decisions.
defaultPrompt: Use the Shogun formation to complete this task in parallel and show concise Sengoku-period drama live council updates.
Delegate research, implementation, and review to separate agents and relay material coordination events in period-drama style.
Use a multi-agent team, make real agent reports visible in Shogun-style dialogue, and return one verified result.
